content.text: Pasting markdown that contains nested unordered or ordered lists into the document editor flattens every item into a single top-level numbered list. Nested structure and bullet markers are lost.
Paste of a commonmark-style snippet with two levels of indentation should produce nested list nodes in the editor document tree, preserving ordered vs unordered type per level.

Instead, the HTML clipboard path runs a list normalizer that walks li elements without reading data-indent or nested ul/ol wrappers from the clipboard HTML. Suspected cause: MarkdownPastePlugin converts nested lists to sequential paragraphs first, then ListInputRule renumbers only top-level blocks, discarding depth metadata from the AST.
Writers who draft in external markdown tools spend extra time re-indenting after every paste.
